18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Deliberate TOL palette with per-rank color encoding, clean legend, and restrained typography work well, but the tree renders in only the upper-left quarter of the viewport leaving a large dead zone of empty space below.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Structural tree visualization with no quantitative encoding violations: color correctly encodes categorical rank, SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, key functions are present for both node and link joins, and descendant counts are computed dynamically — the only minor risk is the name+depth composite key which could theoretically collide but is robust for taxonomic data.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before new transitions on click or expand/collapse, risking snap artifacts mid-animation; all other criteria pass — search is debounced 200ms, Pointer Events API unifies mouse/touch, no brush/zoom storms, and no cross-view feedback loops.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with 6-color Tol palette and progressive disclosure keeps cognitive load low at default depth; search-to-expand and +N count badges manage the ~200-node dataset well, though full expansion could crowd labels at deeper levels.
